section_summary.extract_value: This section details a path analysis conducted to test a theoretical model. It describes the initial model, the sequential elimination of non-significant paths, and the final readjusted model (Fig. 1). The readjusted model explains variances in self-compassion, social safeness, body appreciation, and eating psychopathology, with all path coefficients being statistically significant. Key findings include the negative direct impact of BMI on body appreciation and its direct and indirect effects on disordered eating.
